environment.description: Same application on ECS Fargate behind ALB. CloudFront distribution in front of ALB with origin request policy. Three independent controls: (1) RDS Proxy with pinning enforcement and pg_hint_plan extension disabled, connection-level statement timeout of 50ms via RDS parameter group (statement_timeout=50); (2) IAM database authentication enabled on RDS instance requiring AWS Signature v4 token refresh every 15 minutes - the DB role 'appuser_iam' is granted ONLY pg_read_all_data (read-only predefined role, PostgreSQL 14+), with no EXECUTE on any functions and explicit REVOKE on pg_write_all_data; (3) VPC endpoint policy on the RDS VPC endpoint restricting rds-db:connect action to the ECS task role ARN only, with a condition key limiting source VPC endpoint.
